Simple & Fast

How It Works

Three easy steps to accurate garment sizing.

STEP 01

Lay Flat

Place your trousers flat on any floor or rug with good room lighting. Smooth out major fabric wrinkles.

STEP 02

Aim & Map

Move your phone slowly over the trousers in small circles. The camera maps the floor depth in real 3D.

STEP 03

Instant Results

When the green indicator locks, tap Scan. AI automatically pinpoints key landmarks for exact Waist & Outseam.

Got Questions?

Frequently Asked Questions

How accurate are the measurements?
Our 3D ray-plane intersection engine is calibrated within ±0.5 inches of a tailor's tape measure when trousers are placed flat in good room lighting.
How is the trouser waist size calculated?
The app calculates the flat physical waistband width in inches, then applies the tailor standard formula: (width + 1) × 2, rounded to whole sizes (e.g., 32, 34, 36).
Which devices support live camera scanning?
Native AR camera scanning requires Google Chrome on Android with ARCore. If you are on an iPhone, iPad, Mac, or PC, you can use the Interactive 3D Simulator to test and measure trousers with sample photos.
Are my photos uploaded to a cloud server?
No. Spatial 3D tracking and neural landmark measurements execute locally inside your web browser. Your camera stream is never recorded or stored.
